text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just a bit...
I was up pretty late watching the Satono Group's new product announcement stream...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
They said there's an overseas expansion planned this time,
so as a member of the group, I need to see it through.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Bringing emotion and happiness to people around the world"... I think it's a wonderful project. As a member of it, I will continue to—

Satono Crown couldn't sleep well,
and it seems she didn't get much rest...
